<article id="doctoral-project" class="work-card research-direction-card">
<span class="status-tag">Proposed doctoral project · feasibility and design stage</span>
<h3>Public Risk, Private Control?</h3>
<p class="work-meta">Public-purpose investment in Chile and Malawi</p>
<p>The Chile pilot compares successive generations of public-private partnership contracts from 1993 onward. It uses predecessor-successor asset lineages to test whether redesigned revenue protections, contract terms, and public powers reflect institutional learning, and whether stronger controls displaced investor protection or layered new forms of discipline onto it.</p>
<p>The Malawi pilot reconstructs financing, guarantees, currency exposure, ownership, and decision rights across the Salima and Golomoti solar projects and the Mpatamanga hydropower project. It asks how debt and foreign-exchange constraints shape project selection and the distribution of risk and returns.</p>
</article>

<article id="ai-interest" class="work-card research-direction-card">
<span class="status-tag">Developing research interest</span>
<h3>AI adoption, firms, and work</h3>
<p class="work-meta">Descriptive feasibility stage</p>
<p>I am interested in which firms adopt AI in lower-income economies, which organisational and technical capabilities shape its use, and whether adoption changes tasks, monitoring, and worker discretion.</p>
<p>One feasibility route uses World Bank Enterprise Survey AI follow-ups to measure reported adoption across firm size, exporting, foreign ownership, skills, and prior digital capacity. A causal design would require credible adoption timing, observed use, defensible comparison groups, and adequate follow-up data.</p>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Institutional report · December 2025</span>
<h3>Does Slovenia’s Public Works Programme Improve Health and Social Outcomes?</h3>
<p class="work-meta">OECD · prepared with Matija Vodopivec</p>
<p>The report evaluates Slovenia’s public-works programme using linked employment, health, and social-protection records. OECD is the institutional author; the acknowledgements name Matija Vodopivec and me as preparers.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/about/projects/technical-reports-and-presentations-dg-reform/slovenia/Module4.pdf">Read the report</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Master’s thesis · September 2023, updated</span>
<h3>Reassessing Recent Inequality Trends in Chile: Income, Wealth, and Survey Disagreement, 2007–2024</h3>
<p class="work-meta">Paris School of Economics</p>
<p>The paper asks whether Chile’s well-documented decline in measured inequality persists in a different household-survey system. It combines six waves of the Household Financial Survey with a closest-concept CASEN comparison, income-component accounting, a survivor-domain check, and an audit of the survey ancestry behind international indicators.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="assets/camacho-did-inequality-fall-in-chile.pdf">Read the paper</a><br><a class="text-link" href="assets/camacho-did-inequality-fall-in-chile-supplement.pdf">Technical supplement</a><br><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/inequality-measurement-chile">Code and aggregate results</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Research contribution · 2024–2025 paper</span>
<h3>Market Forces and Employer Racial Preferences</h3>
<p class="work-meta">Joan J. Martínez and Ellora Derenoncourt</p>
<p>I contributed data-source and variable work, constructed the historical job-advertisement corpus, and supported difference-in-differences and event-study analysis. I am not an author of the paper.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://joanjmartinez.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/research/JMartinez_JMP_MarketForces_2025.pdf">Read the paper</a><br><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/newslabor-extract">View my data pipeline</a></div>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Research contribution · CESifo Working Paper 10666</span>
<h3>Conducting Qualitative Interviews with AI</h3>
<p class="work-meta">Felix Chopra and Ingar Haaland</p>
<p>During my NHH pre-doctoral fellowship, I provided research assistance acknowledged in this paper on AI-led qualitative interviews. My public <a href="https://github.com/mkmacho/ai-qualitative-interviews">AI qualitative interviews</a> repository is an independent, Qualtrics-integrated implementation for structured long-form data collection, not an author release of the paper’s research code.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://www.ifo.de/en/cesifo/publications/2026/working-paper/conducting-qualitative-interviews-ai">Publication page</a><br><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/ai-qualitative-interviews">View the public implementation</a></div>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Co-authored methods paper · April 2022</span>
<h3>Robust Inference in the Presence of Weak Instruments</h3>
<p class="work-meta">With Kartika Herscheid and Unai Oyón-Lerga · Paris School of Economics</p>
<p>A retrospective reassessment of 437 just-identified IV specifications from 38 <em>American Economic Journal</em> papers, applying the tF robust-inference adjustment. The exercise documents how the adjustment changes reported inference; it does not re-estimate the original studies.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="assets/robust-inference-weak-instruments.pdf">Read the paper</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Co-authored policy note · March 2022</span>
<h3>Addressing the Enduring Gender Gap in the Chilean Labour Market</h3>
<p class="work-meta">With Kartika Herscheid and Laure Lépine · Paris School of Economics</p>
<p>A policy memo synthesising evidence on childcare access, women’s STEM participation, and information campaigns in Chile. It sets out recommendations and limitations; it is not an original causal evaluation.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="assets/addressing-enduring-gender-gap-chilean-labour-market.pdf">Read the policy note</a></div>
</article>
